description: vpc/v2 — a BREAKING kind_version bump of vpc/v1: adds a REQUIRED `region`. A v1 spec ({account_id, cidr}) is invalid here, so this ships as a NEW kind_version, not an in-place edit. The kind string stays bare `vpc`; the version lives in `kind_version`.

account_id.description: Provider 12-digit account id this VPC lives in.

region.description: Cloud region the VPC is created in (v2, required).
Region the v2 worker placed the VPC in (echoed from spec).

config_schema.description: vpc/v2 operational config — DIFFERENT shape from v1's: adds default_region. This is why a config is per-(kind, kind_version): a vpc/v2 config validates against THIS schema, and a v1 config (no default_region) is a different document for a different kind_version.

flow_logs_bucket.description: S3 bucket VPC flow logs are written to.

default_region.description: Default region for VPCs of this kind/kind_version (v2 config addition).
